title: InventoryRisk
description: Published by the forecaster to retail/inventory/{product_id} on each forecast cycle. QoS 0, retained. Feeds both the dashboard dead-stock alert panel and the pricing agent's reward function.

dead_stock_risk.description: Probability the SKU fails to clear before its sell-by horizon. 0 = no risk, 1 = certain dead stock.

predicted_sellby.description: Forecast date the current stock clears at present velocity. YYYY-MM-DD.

units_on_hand.description: Optional. Current inventory level if known to the forecaster.

model_version.description: e.g. 'stub-0.1', 'prophet-2026-10-01', 'lstm-v2'. Required so forecaster comparisons in the evaluation chapter are attributable.
